saved: True from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    # The more common color is converted to the less common color; the
    # less common color is removed (mapped to 0).
    common, rare = counts.most_common(2)[0][0], counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    return [[rare if value == common else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
